entries.title: I Peter 2:1
segments: ¶Laying aside therefore all malice and all guile and hypocrisies and envyings and all evil speakings,

entries.title: I Peter 2:2
segments: as newborn babes desire earnestly the pure mental milk of the word, that by it ye may grow up to salvation,

entries.title: I Peter 2:3
segments: if indeed ye have tasted that the Lord [is] good.

entries.title: I Peter 2:4
segments: ¶To whom coming, a living stone, cast away indeed as worthless by men, but with God chosen, precious,

entries.title: I Peter 2:5
segments: yourselves also, as living stones, are being built up a spiritual house, a holy priesthood, to offer spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God by Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Peter 2:6
segments: Because it is contained in the scripture: Behold, I lay in Zion a corner stone, elect, precious: and he that believes on him shall not be put to shame.

entries.title: I Peter 2:7
segments: To you therefore who believe [is] the preciousness; but to the disobedient, the stone which the builders cast away as worthless, this is become head of [the] corner,

entries.title: I Peter 2:8
segments: and a stone of stumbling and rock of offence; [who] stumble at the word, being disobedient to which also they have been appointed.

entries.title: I Peter 2:9
segments: But *ye* [are] a chosen race, a kingly priesthood, a holy nation, a people for a possession, that ye might set forth the excellencies of him who has called you out of darkness to his wonderful light;

entries.title: I Peter 2:10
segments: who once [were] not a people, but now God's people; who were not enjoying mercy, but now have found mercy.

entries.title: I Peter 2:11
segments: Beloved, I exhort [you], as strangers and sojourners, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

entries.title: I Peter 2:12
segments: having your conversation honest among the Gentiles, that [as to that] in which they speak against you as evildoers, they may through [your] good works, [themselves] witnessing [them], glorify God in [the] day of visitation.

entries.title: I Peter 2:13
segments: ¶Be in subjection [therefore] to every human institution for the Lord's sake; whether to [the] king as supreme,

entries.title: I Peter 2:14
segments: or to rulers as sent by him, for vengeance on evildoers, and praise to them that do well.

entries.title: I Peter 2:15
segments: Because so is the will of God, that by well-doing ye put to silence the ignorance of senseless men;

entries.title: I Peter 2:16
segments: as free, and not as having liberty as a cloak of malice, but as God's bondmen.

entries.title: I Peter 2:17
segments: Shew honour to all, love the brotherhood, fear God, honour the king.

entries.title: I Peter 2:18
segments: Servants, [be] subject with all fear to your masters, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the ill-tempered.

entries.title: I Peter 2:19
segments: For this [is] acceptable, if one, for conscience sake towards God, endure griefs, suffering unjustly.

entries.title: I Peter 2:20
segments: For what glory [is it], if sinning and being buffeted ye shall bear [it]? but if, doing good and suffering, ye shall bear [it], this is acceptable with God.

entries.title: I Peter 2:21
segments: For to this have ye been called; for Christ also has suffered for you, leaving you a model that ye should follow in his steps:

entries.title: I Peter 2:22
segments: who did no sin, neither was guile found in his mouth;

entries.title: I Peter 2:23
segments: who, [when] reviled, reviled not again; [when] suffering, threatened not; but gave [himself] over into the hands of him who judges righteously;

entries.title: I Peter 2:24
segments: who himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, in order that, being dead to sins, we may live to righteousness: by whose stripes ye have been healed.

entries.title: I Peter 2:25
segments: For ye were going astray as sheep, but have now returned to the shepherd and overseer of your souls.
